rendered: The document does not state an siRNA dose for Gao et al.'s study. The review only describes their formulation: Gao et al. used a novel CL4H6-ionizable lipid, cholesterol, and DMG-PEG2000 (molar ratio 60:40:1[1]) to make LNPs encapsulating si-FOXM1 via the tert-butanol dilution method. Table 2[2] lists this work's si-FOXM1 with a particle size of 90–100 nm[3], and gives no dose. No dose is given in the text or the tables, and no dose unit such as mg/kg, nmol or pmol appears anywhere in the document.[4]
